components.label: Director
components.does: Makes the film. It reads the brief, writes the plan, builds the shots in code, looks at its own frames and decides what to fix.

inside.label: Director skill
inside.does: The workflow the model follows from setup to the finished master.

inside.label: Critic
inside.does: An independent reviewer that grades the master from evidence it gathers itself.

inside.label: Motion Library
inside.does: The craft the model reads on demand: direction, sound, styles and one guide per engine.

components.label: Thesium CLI
components.does: The command you type. Every command works on the film folder you are standing in.

inside.label: Commands
inside.does: Parses the command line and calls one studio operation.

inside.label: Installed launcher
inside.does: The `thesium` command that npm link puts on your path.

components.label: MCP server
components.does: Gives the studio to clients that have no shell, such as Claude Desktop. Stills and sheets come back as images.

inside.label: Studio tools
inside.does: The same operations as the CLI, offered as MCP tools.

components.label: Review studio
components.does: Where you watch the film. You can pin notes on the timeline and tune the parameters the model exposed.

inside.label: Studio page
inside.does: Shows the versions, the named beats on the track and every note as a pin.

inside.label: Studio server
inside.does: Serves only out, review and assets. It saves each note with the exact frame where the person left it.

components.label: Studio operations
components.sublabel: What Thesium does for a film
components.does: The one layer the CLI, the MCP server and the studio all call, so every interface behaves the same.

inside.label: Studio operations
inside.does: Stills, strips, previews, checks, masters and notes, all from one place.

inside.label: One-command make
inside.does: Turns a request into a film folder and a headless director session that finishes the film.

inside.label: Sound commands
inside.does: Scores, sound effects, narration, beat tracking and the loudness checks.

inside.label: Material
inside.does: Captures web pages as real material and writes real QR codes.

inside.label: Python helper
inside.does: Finds Python and the sound packages the kit needs.

components.label: Engines
components.does: Drives whichever renderer you chose, from a web page to any command line such as Blender. Every renderer draws the same thing: the image at time t.

inside.label: Engine contract
inside.does: Says what a renderer must do, and the rules a film's source must follow.

inside.label: Web engine
inside.does: Renders a page that draws the frame, in headless Chrome.

inside.label: EffectCraft driver
inside.does: Builds an AE-style script and draws its frames.

inside.label: Remotion driver
inside.does: Bundles a React project once, then draws from it.

inside.label: HyperFrames driver
inside.does: Snapshots and renders an HTML timeline with GSAP.

components.label: Rendering
components.does: Turns the engine's frames into the images you look at and the film you watch, with the motion blur the master will have.

inside.label: Stills and strips
inside.does: Renders exact times and tiles neighbouring frames into one sheet.

inside.label: Video and motion blur
inside.does: Renders the whole film, averaging the samples inside each frame's shutter.

components.label: Browser
components.does: Draws the web films in the Chrome already on your machine, and serves the studio page from the film folder.

inside.label: Chrome driver
inside.does: Speaks to headless Chrome over a pipe, with no Playwright and no WebSocket.

inside.label: Loopback file server
inside.does: Serves the studio page and the film's files over 127.0.0.1 only.

components.label: Media and sound
components.does: Does the measuring and mixing: contact sheets, loudness, ducking, mastering and the numbers behind them.

inside.label: FFmpeg helpers
inside.does: Grabs frames, builds labelled sheets and probes every file.

inside.label: Sound mix
inside.does: Mixes the stems, ducks the music under narration and masters to the loudness target.

components.label: Quality gates
components.does: Catches what the model cannot see: empty bands, flat colour, a wrong language on screen, a film that changes between two runs.

inside.label: Frame check
inside.does: Measures empty edges and flat colour fields on raw pixels of any engine's output.

inside.label: Language check
inside.does: Checks that the words on screen are the language the brief asked for.

components.label: Film workspace
components.does: Keeps the film. Everything about it, its source, its material and its evidence, lives in one folder on your machine.

inside.label: The manifest
inside.does: One file, thesium.json, that says what the film is: engine, size, timing, sound and tunables.

inside.label: Film folders
inside.does: Creates the folder, writes the brief, the plan and the house rules, and finds it again.

inside.label: Paths
inside.does: Resolves every path and refuses the ones that would leave the film folder.

inside.label: Process control
inside.does: Runs the outside programs and reports what they said.

inside.label: Disk and vendor
inside.does: Checks that the drive has room, and fetches optional browser libraries once.

components.label: In-film kit
components.does: The helpers the film carries with it, so a film renders on its own machine without Thesium's source tree.

inside.label: Web motion kit
inside.does: Motion vocabulary for a web film: easing, reveals and the timeline helpers.

inside.label: Score synth
inside.does: Writes the film's music: drums, basses, pads, arps and the mix bus.

inside.label: Voice kit
inside.does: The speech tools the narration command uses.

components.label: Examples
components.does: Shows finished films and the code behind them. Each one proves that the same plan works on another engine.

inside.label: The launch film
inside.does: A 30-second launch film, made on EffectCraft through Thesium.

inside.label: Hears every word
inside.does: A 24-second narrated film, drawn from Thesium's own check of its voice-over.

inside.label: Two more engines
inside.does: The launch film again, this time on HyperFrames and on Remotion.
